verdict.rationale: Warp's own docs say you can click a file path in terminal output or an AI conversation and choose "Open in Warp," so clickable file paths are a documented first-party capability. Nothing in the pack covers clicking URLs or selecting links from the keyboard, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: clickable URL support, keyboard-driven link/path selection, independent or hands-on corroboration.
